title: 第一卷 第19章 纯阴之体第一卷 第20章 怎么这么能吸
slug: 徒儿下山祸害你七个师姐去吧

“嗯，辛苦了。”
黄元洲点头。
随后，他的目光看向叶青云，开口道。
“叶神医，我孙女这病……”
“我能解决，你先出去，没有特殊情况，不要打扰我。”
叶青云眼神注视着床上的黄冰巧，回道。
黄元洲一愣，反应过来后，连连回道。
“好的，叶神医，我这就离开！
你有什么要求尽管提！”
黄元洲说完，带着房间里的其他佣人一并离开房间。
很快，这房间就只剩下叶青云和黄冰巧两人。
黄元洲一离开房间。
胡中一便迎上前来，急切地问道。
“老黄，叶大师怎么说？”
“他说冰巧这病能治。”
胡中一得到这个回答，长呼了口气，面露笑容，拍了拍老黄的肩膀。
“那就没问题了，叶先生这么说。
那冰巧的苦日子就熬过头了。”
黄元洲眼见胡中一如此笃定，忍不住问道。

“老胡，你就这么相信这位叶神医？
我看他的年纪并也不大吧？”
胡中一察觉到黄元洲对叶青云有所轻视，脸上带有不悦。
“老黄，我劝你对叶大师尊重点。
你别看他年轻，他那一手医术可远超于我！
我这一手鬼门七针，为我博得了‘妙手神医’的美称，够厉害吧？
但我想拜叶大师为师，他没同意！”
黄元洲闻言，满脸震惊！
他是知道面前这位老友的秉性的。
一生痴迷于中医，在中医上的造诣极为不凡。
结果胡中一想拜那位叶神医为师？！
胡中一继续说道。
“而且，今天在叶先生的教导下，我已经学会了鬼门十三针！”
“真的？！”
黄元洲被震惊得脱口而出。
“那是自然，今日你运气好，我刚学会鬼门十三针，正好给你施展下。
帮你活络一下全身气血。”
“好好好！话说老胡你好久都没有给我施展鬼门针法了。
我想找你，还得预约，你可太不厚道了！”
黄元洲说着，拉着胡中一前去另一个房间。

这两位老头的心情都很不错。
胡中一刚好可以拿黄元洲试验一下他新学的鬼门十三针。

"Well, thank you for your hard work."
Huang Yuanzhou nodded.
Then, he looked at Ye Qingyun and said.
"Mr. Ye, my granddaughter has this disease..."
"I can handle it. You go out first. If there are no special circumstances, don't disturb me."
Ye Qingyun looked at Huang Bingqiao on the bed and replied.
Huang Yuanzhou was stunned for a moment, and after he came to his senses, he replied.
"Okay, Doctor Ye, I'll leave now!
If you have any requests, just ask! "
After Huang Yuanzhou finished speaking, he left the room with the other servants in the room.
Soon, only Ye Qingyun and Huang Bingqiao were left in the room.
As soon as Huang Yuanzhou left the room.
Hu Zhongyi came forward and asked eagerly.
"Old Huang, what did Master Ye say?"
"He said Bingqiao's disease can be cured."
As soon as Hu Zhong got this answer, he took a long breath, smiled, and patted Lao Huang on the shoulder.
"That's no problem, Mr. Ye said.
Bingqiao's hard life was over. "
Huang Yuanzhou couldn't help but ask when he saw Hu Zhongyi was so sure.
"Lao Hu, do you really believe in this Dr. Ye?
I think he's not that old, right? "
Hu Zhongyi noticed that Huang Yuanzhou despised Ye Qingyun, and there was displeasure on his face.
"Old Huang, I advise you to respect Master Ye.
Even though he is young, his medical skills are far superior to mine!
My Seven Needles of the Ghost Gate has earned me the reputation of the ‘wonderful doctor’. Isn’t it impressive enough?
But I wanted to become Master Ye’s disciple, but he didn’t agree! "
Huang Yuanzhou was shocked when he heard this!
He knew the character of his old friend in front of him.
He has been obsessed with Chinese medicine all his life, and his attainments in Chinese medicine are extremely extraordinary.
As a result, Hu Zhongyi wanted to become a disciple of that Divine Doctor Ye? !
Hu Zhongyi continued.
"Moreover, under Mr. Ye's guidance today, I have learned the Thirteen Needles of the Ghost Gate!"
"Really?!"
Huang Yuanzhou was so shocked that he blurted out.
"That's natural. You are lucky today. I have just learned the Thirteen Needles of the Ghost Gate, and I can use them on you just in time.
Help you activate your whole body's energy and blood. "
"Okay, okay! By the way, Lao Hu, you haven't used Guimen Acupuncture on me for a long time.
I want to see you, but I have to make an appointment. You are so rude! "
Huang Yuanzhou said, pulling Hu Zhongyi forward to another room.
The two old men were in a good mood.
Hu Zhongyi could just use Huang Yuanzhou to test his newly learned Thirteen Needles of Ghost Gate.
